subtitle: Out Manila · Air China
overview: Fly with Air China into Chengdu and drive to Chongqing for old-town streets, Liziba light-rail station and the Hongya Cave night view. Then continue to Dujiangyan and Chengdu for the Panda Park, Broad and Narrow Alley and Chunxi Road. Four nights in local 5-star hotels; the rate includes three shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 22–26 2026 to Nov 22–26 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Ciqikou Ancient Town: A restored riverside old town in Chongqing with traditional streets, tea houses and snacks.
placeDesc.Liziba Station: A Chongqing light rail station where the train runs through a residential building, a popular photo spot.
placeDesc.Jiefangbei: Chongqing's central pedestrian shopping district, built around a commemorative monument.
placeDesc.Bayi Food Street: A Chongqing street known for local Chongqing food and snacks, eaten at your own expense.
placeDesc.Kuixing Tower: A Chongqing building where the 22nd floor is level with the street, a curiosity of the city's hilly terrain.
placeDesc.Chaotianmen Square: A waterfront square in Chongqing at the meeting point of the Yangtze and Jialing rivers.
placeDesc.Hongya Cave: A stacked, stilt-style building complex in Chongqing, famous for its glowing night view.
placeDesc.Yangtianwo Square: A town square in Dujiangyan with a panda statue, popular for selfies.
placeDesc.Zhongshuge: A visually striking bookstore known for its mirrored, immersive interior design.
placeDesc.South Bridge: A bridge over the Min River in Dujiangyan, a pleasant riverside viewpoint.
placeDesc.Panda Park: A panda centre in the Dujiangyan area where visitors can see giant pandas; battery bus included.
placeDesc.Florentia Village: An outlet shopping village in Chengdu, designed as a European-style town.
placeDesc.Broad and Narrow Alley: A historic area of Chengdu with traditional courtyard lanes, shops and tea houses.
placeDesc.Sino-Ocean Taikoo Li: An open-air shopping district in Chengdu with a naked-eye 3D LED screen.
placeDesc.Chunxi Road: Chengdu's main downtown shopping street, lined with malls and stores.
